# Anbennar Overhaul: generated by tools/build_advancements.py from tools/data/advancements.py; do not edit by hand.

# Character scope (the mage). Level effects: aov_advancement_level_effects.txt (hand-written).

aov_adv_magical_fortress_start = {
	custom_tooltip = aov_adv_magical_fortress_cost_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		remove_short_term_gold = aov_adv_magical_fortress_next_gold
		aov_mana_spend = { AMOUNT = aov_adv_magical_fortress_next_mana }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = aov_studying }
			remove_variable = aov_studying
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = aov_adv_working_level
			value = {
				value = aov_adv_magical_fortress_level
				add = 1
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = aov_adv_committed value = flag:magical_fortress }
		set_variable = { name = aov_adv_progress value = 0 }
	}
}

aov_adv_magical_fortress_complete = {
	set_variable = { name = aov_adv_magical_fortress_lvl value = var:aov_adv_working_level }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = aov_adv value = flag:magical_fortress }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = aov_adv_level value = var:aov_adv_working_level }
	aov_adv_abandon = yes
	if = {
		limit = { scope:aov_adv_level = 1 }
		aov_adv_magical_fortress_1_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:aov_adv_level = 2 }
		aov_adv_magical_fortress_2_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:aov_adv_level = 3 }
		aov_adv_magical_fortress_3_effect = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:aov_adv_own_event } }
		trigger_event = aov_advancement.1
	}
}

# Ends the commitment; nothing is refunded
aov_adv_abandon = {
	remove_variable = aov_adv_committed
	remove_variable = aov_adv_working_level
	remove_variable = aov_adv_progress
}

# AI (aov_adv_ai_yearly): start one affordable level, weighted toward the mage's best schools
aov_adv_ai_pick = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				aov_adv_magical_fortress_can_start = yes
				aov_adv_summon_extraplanars_can_start = yes
				aov_adv_orb_of_omniscience_can_start = yes
				aov_adv_enchanted_artifact_can_start = yes
				aov_adv_battlemage_academy_can_start = yes
				aov_adv_mirror_image_can_start = yes
				aov_adv_lichdom_can_start = yes
				aov_adv_homunculus_can_start = yes
			}
		}
		random_list = {
			10 = {
				trigger = {
					aov_adv_magical_fortress_can_start = yes
				}
				modifier = {
					add = {
						value = aov_school_abjuration_level
						multiply = 10
					}
				}
				aov_adv_magical_fortress_start = yes
			}
			10 = {
				trigger = {
					aov_adv_summon_extraplanars_can_start = yes
				}
				modifier = {
					add = {
						value = aov_school_conjuration_level
						multiply = 10
					}
				}
				aov_adv_summon_extraplanars_start = yes
			}
			10 = {
				trigger = {
					aov_adv_orb_of_omniscience_can_start = yes
				}
				modifier = {
					add = {
						value = aov_school_divination_level
						multiply = 10
					}
				}
				aov_adv_orb_of_omniscience_start = yes
			}
			10 = {
				trigger = {
					aov_adv_enchanted_artifact_can_start = yes
				}
				modifier = {
					add = {
						value = aov_school_enchantment_level
						multiply = 10
					}
				}
				aov_adv_enchanted_artifact_start = yes
			}
			10 = {
				trigger = {
					aov_adv_battlemage_academy_can_start = yes
				}
				modifier = {
					add = {
						value = aov_school_evocation_level
						multiply = 10
					}
				}
				aov_adv_battlemage_academy_start = yes
			}
			10 = {
				trigger = {
					aov_adv_mirror_image_can_start = yes
				}
				modifier = {
					add = {
						value = aov_school_illusion_level
						multiply = 10
					}
				}
				aov_adv_mirror_image_start = yes
			}
			10 = {
				trigger = {
					aov_adv_lichdom_can_start = yes
					OR = {
						has_trait = forbidden_magic_practitioner
						aov_dark_magic_risky = no
					}
				}
				modifier = {
					add = {
						value = aov_school_necromancy_level
						multiply = 10
					}
				}
				aov_adv_lichdom_start = yes
			}
			10 = {
				trigger = {
					aov_adv_homunculus_can_start = yes
				}
				modifier = {
					add = {
						value = aov_school_transmutation_level
						multiply = 10
					}
				}
				aov_adv_homunculus_start = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

# Quarterly (common/on_action/aov_advancement_on_actions.txt): three months of progress
aov_adv_quarterly = {
	if = {
		limit = { aov_adv_is_committed = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { aov_adv_eligible = no }
			aov_adv_abandon = yes
		}
		else = {
			change_variable = { name = aov_adv_progress add = 3 }
			if = {
				limit = { var:aov_adv_progress >= aov_adv_months_needed }
				if = {
					limit = { aov_adv_working_on = { KEY = magical_fortress } }
					aov_adv_magical_fortress_complete = yes
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { aov_adv_working_on = { KEY = summon_extraplanars } }
					aov_adv_summon_extraplanars_complete = yes
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { aov_adv_working_on = { KEY = orb_of_omniscience } }
					aov_adv_orb_of_omniscience_complete = yes
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { aov_adv_working_on = { KEY = enchanted_artifact } }
					aov_adv_enchanted_artifact_complete = yes
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { aov_adv_working_on = { KEY = battlemage_academy } }
					aov_adv_battlemage_academy_complete = yes
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { aov_adv_working_on = { KEY = mirror_image } }
					aov_adv_mirror_image_complete = yes
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { aov_adv_working_on = { KEY = lichdom } }
					aov_adv_lichdom_complete = yes
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { aov_adv_working_on = { KEY = homunculus } }
					aov_adv_homunculus_complete = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
